AppState.description: Global persistent state of basketball shooting peer feedback app including classes, students, feedbacks, questions, and answers

classes.description: List of classrooms (grade and class number)

students.description: List of enrolled students by class

studentAnswers.description: Daily question answers submitted by students

/app_state/{stateId}.description: Stores the central persistent application data and roster
